breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. For a 2D simulation in OpenFOAM (achieved by having a single cell in the z-direction), the front and back patches must be of type 'empty'. The agent incorrectly specified 'noSlip' for the front and back patches for every single field (k, epsilon, nut, alphat, U, T, p, p_rgh), which treats them as solid walls and contradicts the requirements of a 2D simulation.
